summary: Ansible 10.6.0 deprecations: community.network is deprecated and will be removed in Ansible 12 unless someone maintains it, and google.cloud will be removed in Ansible 12 for failing inclusion requirements (unresolved sanity test failures).
questions: Why is google.cloud being removed from the Ansible package?
When will google.cloud be dropped from Ansible?

answer_card.title: community.network and google.cloud deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- `community.network` is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 12 unless it gets a new maintainer.
- `google.cloud` will be removed from Ansible 12 because of unresolved sanity test failures (inclusion requirements). The removal can be cancelled if fixed.
